subject.title: fix(agents): memoize exec auto-reviewer verdicts for identical requests (#102249)

question: Should OpenClaw allow per-reviewer-instance reuse of model-backed exec reviewer allow-once decisions, and must that cache key cover the exact reviewer prompt or full normalized `ExecAutoReviewInput`?
rationale: Exec auto-review sits on the process execution approval boundary, so reusing a model verdict changes one-request-one-review semantics and needs explicit maintainer intent even after the key is corrected.

options.title: Approve exact-input memo after repair
options.body: Require the PR to key by the exact reviewed input, keep the cache non-persistent and bounded, and add real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Keep one-review-per-request
options.body: Reject memoization for this approval path and accept the repeated reviewer cost until a broader approval design is chosen.

options.title: Defer to a broader approval-cache design
options.body: Pause this PR and design reviewer caching together with node, gateway, and plugin harness approval semantics.

recommendation.title: Approve exact-input memo after repair
recommendation.body: Require the PR to key by the exact reviewed input, keep the cache non-persistent and bounded, and add real behavior proof before merge.
